Per Shams, Tacko Fall is signing a two-way deal with the 76ers.

Thrilled to see Fall get another NBA opportunity and that his injury didn't cost him this chance.

items.title: The Celtics have officially announced Payton Pritchard's contract extension.
items.author: Bobby Krivitsky
items.body_excerpt:
The Celtics have officially announced Payton Pritchard's contract extension.

The $21.2M he signed for in 2028-29 is the maximum he was eligible for.

Then, he becomes extension eligible in October of 2028, a year in advance of the $22.9M mutual option for the 2029-2030 season.

I'm anticipating that Milos Uzan, Tucker DeVries, Gabe McGlothan, and Hayden Gray will be part of a loaded Maine Celtics roster.
